scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/stage && cp package.json package-lock.json server.ts dist/stage/ && npm --prefix dist/stage ci --omit=dev --no-audit --no-fund --prefer-offline && (cd dist/stage && 7z a -tzip -mmt=on ../app.zip .)
scripts.deploy: npm run build && az webapp deploy --name mikeharder-test-web-app --resource-group mikeharder-test-plan --src-path dist/app.zip --type zip
scripts.provision: az group create -n mikeharder-test-plan -l westus2 && az appservice plan create -g mikeharder-test-plan -n mikeharder-test-plan --sku P0V4 --is-linux && az webapp create -g mikeharder-test-plan -n mikeharder-test-web-app --plan mikeharder-test-plan --runtime "NODE:24-lts" && az webapp config appsettings set -g mikeharder-test-plan -n mikeharder-test-web-app --settings SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT=false WEBSITE_RUN_FROM_PACKAGE=1
